# Patreon sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Get Patreon campaign totals

Reads your Patreon campaign's totals, like how many patrons pay and how much a month, to say in chat or show.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%patreonPatronCount%` | How many patrons the campaign has |
| `%patreonPaidCount%` | How many paying patrons Cuebot knows |
| `%patreonMonthly%` | The paying patrons' pledges per month added up |
| `%patreonCurrency%` | The campaign's currency, like USD |
| `%patreonCampaign%` | The campaign's name |

<small>Type id: `patreon.getCampaign`</small>

## Get Patreon patron

Checks whether a viewer is your Patreon patron, for chat perks and greetings. Works for patrons who linked Twitch or YouTube on Patreon.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Which platform the viewer is on: twitch, youtube or discord. %platform% is the chatter's. Starts as: `%platform%`. |
| **User id** | The viewer's user id. %userId% is the chatter's. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **User name** | The viewer's name. Used for Twitch when the patron linked Twitch by name only. Starts as: `%userName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%isPatron%` | True if the viewer is an active patron |
| `%isPayingPatron%` | True if they pay now (not a free trial or a gift) |
| `%patreonName%` | Their name on Patreon |
| `%patreonTier%` | Their tier |
| `%patreonStatus%` | Their status, like active_patron |
| `%patreonAmount%` | Their pledge per month |
| `%patreonSince%` | When they started, like 2026-01-15 |

<small>Type id: `patreon.getPatron`</small>

## Sync Patreon members now

Reads your Patreon member list now (Cuebot also does it every 6 hours). Needs the Patreon API connected on the Webhooks page.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%patreonPatronCount%` | How many patrons the campaign has |
| `%patreonPaidCount%` | How many paying patrons Cuebot knows |
| `%patreonMonthly%` | The paying patrons' pledges per month added up |
| `%patreonCurrency%` | The campaign's currency, like USD |
| `%patreonCampaign%` | The campaign's name |
| `%patreonSyncResult%` | What happened, like "Synced 12 Patreon member(s)." |

<small>Type id: `patreon.syncMembers`</small>
